title: Furthest Building You Can Reach
goal: Reach the farthest building using limited bricks and ladders.
strategy: Among positive climbs seen so far, ladders should cover the largest. Keep candidate ladder climbs sorted and pay bricks for the smallest whenever their count exceeds the ladder supply.
